detail:
Command core landed in the cli-2.17 worktree. src/core/command-def.ts holds CommandDef/commandFactory/registerCommands (the MCP adapter reproducing toolResult/toolError exactly); src/core/commands/*.ts hold the 39 handler bodies; src/core/commands.ts assembles the registry; src/core/context.ts holds createTwiningContext extracted from createServer.

Two seams that mattered:
(1) registerXTools signatures were kept BYTE-IDENTICAL and now build a narrow per-module ctx object internally. test/plugin-tool-references.test.ts enumerates the tool surface by calling every registerXTools with `null as never` engines and a recording stub — changing the signatures to take a TwiningContext would have broken it, and that file is also dirty in the other lane's tree. Narrow ctx interfaces (BlackboardCtx, DecisionCtx, ...) keep the handlers type-checked; TwiningContext structurally satisfies all of them, and CommandDef's handler uses METHOD syntax so bivariance lets CommandDef<NarrowCtx> land in a CommandDef<TwiningContext> registry without casts.
(2) Error-code neutrality. Nine pre-2.17 handlers (twining_why, twining_triage, read/query/recent, the three housekeeping tools, every coordination tool) had a catch with NO TwiningError branch — a TwiningError escaping those engines became INTERNAL_ERROR. Centralising the wrapper would have silently widened those codes (e.g. FORMAT_VERSION_TOO_NEW in read-only mode). Preserved with a per-command `errors: "internal-only"` flag; handler-level early `return toolError(...)` became `throw new CommandError(msg, code)`, which is always typed, so twining_why's INVALID_INPUT and twining_commits' INVALID_INPUT still come out unchanged.
summary: 2.17.0 CLI lane: 39 tool handlers extracted to src/core/commands/*; src/tools/*.ts are now registration loops; parity test green
